scope: Reviewable current-user logon startup bundle, explicit Task Scheduler administration and actual hidden launcher. No actual task registration or physical machine activation.

contract.registered_definition_check: Full COM-normalized definition equality except Settings.Enabled
contract.removal: Exact unchanged definition, disabled, no Task Scheduler instances; retains all files and does not prove orphaned process stopped
contract.startup_after_unclean_reboot: Old lock is retained and startup refused until operator recovery verifies prior execution
contract.logs: New private run-UUID.jsonl per attempt; ~1MiB cap plus one marker; no automatic deletion or directory-wide quota

validation.counts_note: 9 startup cases and7 unchanged host cases; later stronger assertion in one existing startup case re-ran independently, not counted twice. Product source unchanged after final16 pass.

actual_observations: Preparing startup bundle leaves node database bytes unchanged and creates no runtime instance.
Task Scheduler COM accepts XML with validation-only flag; actual status confirms that exact task was not registered.
Hidden PowerShell launches actual Node/MCP on literal Unicode, ampersand, parentheses and dollar paths; unauthenticated MCP request is401.
Second actual PowerShell launcher returns failure while existing host remains live; NODE_RUNTIME_BUSY recorded, no second lifecycle instance.
Durable drain ends exact host and wrapper with success, closes MCP and leaves no provider task_runs.
Changed reviewed digest/XML/config/Node pin/user SID/dirty source rejected; inspect/status still available after config changes.
New output requirement preserves existing bundle and rejects percent expansion paths.
simulated_observations: In-memory Task Scheduler registry verifies initial disabled TASK_CREATE, enable/start/disable/remove sequence. Real COM normalizes definitions, but no mutating call reaches the Windows registry.
Altered registered definition, duplicate registration and active removal rejected.

initial_failures.cause: PowerShell wrapper failed; later isolated diagnostics identified unavailable Get-FileHash. Use .NET SHA256 instead.
Native-stderr handling alone did not fix original failure; not counted as success.
COM XML declaration encoded as UTF-8 conflicted with Unicode BSTR; removed encoding attribute, retaining XML content and settings.
Mock missing-task ScriptMethod exception differed from native COM. Fixture changed to null missing entry and explicit exit handling; production ownership checks retained.
